extension.description: Display current time, current temperature and media playing time remaining on a YoctoMaxiDisplay screen.
extension.news:
v0.2.9 - Renamed the addon to "YoctoDisplay" (was "Kodi YoctoDisplay") - addon ID is unchanged
v0.2.8 - Update vendored Yoctopuce SDK (2.1.6320 to 2.1.15129) - Keep retrying to connect indefinitely - picks up the display whenever it's plugged in, and recovers automatically if disconnected mid-session, instead of giving up after one failed attempt - Notifications now include the actual error, not just "see logs" - Properly release the Yocto API on shutdown/profile switch, and don't crash if the display disappears mid-session - Brightness/LED setting changes now apply live, without needing a restart - Fix display orientation being wrong at boot (including the Yoctopuce boot logo) - self-corrects and saves to the device's flash once, rather than every startup - Narrow the Linux ARM library-selection override (was forcing 'armhf' on any non-Windows platform, not just 32-bit ARM)
